properties.name: datawise.sse.bus-type
properties.description: SSE bus backend: in-memory (default) or jdbc (requires metadata DataSource).

properties.name: datawise.sse.instance-id
properties.description: Optional publish origin id; empty = spring.application.name@host:pid.

properties.name: datawise.sse.jdbc.poll-interval
properties.description: How often JDBC bus polls dw_sse_events for new rows.

properties.name: datawise.sse.jdbc.retention
properties.description: Delete JDBC SSE events older than this retention window.
